title: Coder before 2.29.17, 2.30.0 before 2.32.7, 2.33.0 before 2.33.8, and 2.34.0 before 2.34.2 contains a stored HTML injection vulnerability because… (CVE-2026-111932)
description: Coder versions before 2.29.17, 2.30.0 before 2.32.7, 2.33.0 before 2.33.8, and 2.34.0 before 2.34.2 contain a stored HTML injection vulnerability. This occurs because the ApplicationName and LogoURL appearance settings are rendered into HTML output without sufficient escaping. Attackers with the Owner role can inject HTML markup that is displayed in the Coder dashboard and in SMTP notification emails sent to other users. The vulnerability has a medium severity with a CVSS score of 3.4.
aiSummary: The vulnerability in Coder involves stored HTML injection due to insufficient escaping of the ApplicationName and LogoURL settings. An attacker with Owner privileges can insert malicious HTML code into these settings, which then gets rendered in the dashboard interface and in email notifications to other users. This could lead to limited integrity impacts but does not affect confidentiality or availability. The affected versions are prior to 2.29.17, 2.32.7, 2.33.8, and 2.34.2 respectively for the specified version branches.
aiImpact: The vulnerability allows an attacker with Owner role to inject HTML content that is rendered in the user interface and email notifications. This can lead to limited integrity impact such as UI manipulation or phishing attempts within the context of the application. There is no direct confidentiality or availability impact reported. No known exploits are currently in the wild.
